svg.title: The isolated zero-momentum convention is irrelevant. Physical waves are symmetric under simul- taneous label/momentum permutations and transverse under Πab(k) = δab −kakb/|k|2 in each slot. Translations multiply by total-momentum plane waves with P(k) = P i(|ki|, ki); the vacuum is the unit zero-sector wave. The comparison assumes a complex-linear isometry U : H →Famb with phys- ical image, preserving the selected vacuum and intertwining translations. Neither onto-ness nor a full field identification is required. For real electric tests h set zh(c, a; k) = P b Πab(k)|k|bhc,b,+(|k|, k) and
